response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack/web software engineer with a strong track record in TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang, plus some low-latency backend work, but the role requires deep hardware expertise: SoC/IP modeling, AI accelerator architecture, GPU/SIMD-MIMD workload analysis, and hardware-software co-design. The resume shows no evidence of chip modeling, computer architecture, performance/power trade-off prototyping, or deep-learning training/inference optimization. The only adjacent items are brief C/C++ work at National Instruments, a wave-field-synthesis thesis, and generic 'embedded systems' mentions, which fall far short of principal-level hardware architecture. Education (BS CS) meets the 8+ years bar numerically, but the domain experience requirement is unmet.
strengths: 15+ years of software engineering across many domains
Some C/C++ and embedded/hardware-adjacent exposure (National Instruments, robotics)
concerns: No SoC/IP modeling or computer architecture experience
No AI accelerator, GPU, or deep-learning workload optimization background
Career profile is web/full-stack, not principal-level hardware IC

key_factors.factor: Missing SoC/IP modeling and hardware architecture skills
No AI accelerator / GPU / DNN optimization experience
Long tenure and breadth of software engineering experience
